changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Migrate is_dry_run to status and remove column
changeSet.sql: UPDATE n_bulk_operation SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'UPLOADED' AND is_dry_run = true THEN 'UPLOADED_DRY_RUN' WHEN status = 'VALIDATION_IN_PROGRESS' AND is_dry_run = true THEN 'VALIDATION_IN_PROGRESS_DRY_RUN' WHEN status = 'VALIDATED' AND is_dry_run = true THEN 'VALIDATED_DRY_RUN' ELSE status END WHERE is_dry_run = true;
